The '''Grindavík men's football team''' is the men's [[Association football|football]] department of the [[Ungmennafélag Grindavíkur]] [[multi-sport club]]. It is based in [[Grindavík]] in south-west [[Iceland]], and currently plays in the [[1. deild karla (football)|Lengjudeildin]], the second tier in Icelandic football."}}
